title: OpenAI available at FedRAMP Moderate
summary: OpenAI is available at FedRAMP Moderate authorization for ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API, enabling secure AI adoption for U.S. federal agencies.
body: OpenAI is available at FedRAMP Moderate authorization for ChatGPT Enterprise and the OpenAI API, enabling secure AI adoption for U.S. federal agencies.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布ChatGPT Enterprise及API已获得FedRAMP Moderate授权，标志着其模型服务正式符合美国联邦政府的安全合规标准，为政府机构采用生成式AI扫清了障碍。

aiReview.reasonZh: FedRAMP认证是AI模型进入美国政府市场的关键合规里程碑，具有行业参考价值。
